title: Thompson Sampling over Prompt Variants
hints: Per request: activate any variant whose launch_at equals this index, then call sample_beta(alpha, beta) once for every active variant in list order, and serve the argmax (ties go to the earlier variant).
Only the served variant learns from the request. In production you never see what the other prompts would have done.
Warm start with integer math: s = (warm_weight * a_p) // (a_p + b_p), prior = (1 + s, 1 + warm_weight - s), using the parent's posterior at the moment of launch.
The leader is the highest posterior mean a / (a + b) among variants that actually served traffic. Compare by cross-multiplying so ties are exact, and break ties by list order.
